messages:
maya: FYI customer reported tool-call failure with prompthook via streaming. They get a schema validation error because the tool args arrive as partial JSON (truncated mid-object) on resume. Customer saw `400` from our API and the model-side tool never executes.

maya: Repro steps from customer: SSE stream, server sends chunks; client reconnects on keepalive, resumes and receives last chunk cut off. They pasted the last few chunks: 
```
event: data
data: {\"tool\": \"fetch_price\", \"args\": {\"ticker\": \"AAPL\", \"options\": {\"range\": \"1d\"\"\n// stream ends here (no closing braces)
```

jordan: Got it. Is this happening only on hosted API or also Dedicated? Any proxy/load balancer in front?

maya: Hosted API for this customer, region us-west-2. They mentioned a CDN edge + our proxy. Trace: trace_id=tr-0a1b2c3d. They said it reliably happens when the stream resumes after a keepalive chunk.

liam: Can you paste the raw SSE frames (with chunk boundaries)? If the keepalive splits inside a multibyte token or mid-json, that could explain. Also need request headers (Transfer-Encoding) and whether http/2 is used.

maya: Raw frames (redacted):
```
:keepalive


event: model.chunk
data: {\"type\": \"toolcall\", \"payload\": \"{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"fetch_price\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"ticker\\\":\\\"AAPL\\\",\\\"options\\\":{\\\"range\\\":\\\"1d\\\"\\\"}\"}\n

// next frame (after reconnect)
event: model.chunk
data: {\"type\": \"toolcall\", \"payload\": \"...\\\\n\\\"currency\\\":\\\"USD\\\"}\\\"\n```

qa-jen: Looks like the payload got split and the second chunk starts with an ellipsis from the client reassembly. If the client or any proxy removes or injects bytes during resume, the JSON will be corrupted. Do we have any logs showing our edge rewriting or trimming data on reconnect?

sre-bot: [alert] 2024-06-15T18:40:12Z edge-proxy us-west-2 reported connection-resume and 499-abort anomalies (recent spike).

liam: Thanks. Hypothesis: keepalive heartbeat inserted by CDN causes chunk boundary to fall inside a JSON string; on reconnect the client attempts to stitch based on event order but our proxy might drop an empty keepalive frame, leaving a hole. Need to check whether our SSE reassembly guarantees preserve raw byte sequence for multi-frame tool payloads.

jordan: Assigning to eng-runtime for deeper trace. @liam can you capture a pcap for the next repro or enable debug logging on that trace_id?

liam: Will enable debug logs for trace_id tr-0a1b2c3d and pin curl/capture repro. Also add a transient mitigation: server-side should validate and reject incomplete toolcall payloads with a clearer error code (e.g., 422 partial-json) and include resume_offset so client can retry safely.

maya: Customer asked for a workaround now — suggested they switch to non-streaming mode for tool calls or have client append a JSON checksum/end-marker and validate before forwarding to us. They prefer we fix on our side.

jordan: Create internal ticket INF-4821 with logs + pcap + repro script. Tag eng-runtime, edge, and support. Add note: likely related to keepalive splitting on CDN -> proxy resume.

maya: Created INF-4821 and linked to customer case CASE-9892. Customer notified we'll investigate and gave tentative ETA 48h. :thumbsup:

liam: Quick repro script to try locally (useful for QA):
```bash
# simulate SSE that splits a JSON inside a chunk boundary
( printf 'event: data\ndata: {\"tool\":\"fetch_price\",\"args\":{\"ticker\":\"AAPL\",\"options\":{\"range\":\"1d\"' ; sleep 0.2 ; printf '}}\n\n' ) | nc -l 8080
# client should reconnect mid-stream and attempt to reassemble chunks
```

qa-jen: I'll run this in the staging environment with our CDN emulation and report back. If we can reproduce consistently we can add a fix for byte-preserving reassembly or a server-side streaming framing marker to avoid ambiguous boundaries.

maya: Thanks all — keeping thread updated as QA reproduces.
